responsibility: Declares and implements the top-level function-to-BIR lowering driver for gccrs borrow checking. For each HIR function it creates the BIR Function object, instantiates universal free regions from function lifetime parameters and constraints, reserves and annotates the return place, lowers parameters including destructuring patterns, invokes the expression/statement builder on the function body, and ensures a terminating return, making this file the entry point that assembles complete per-function BIR from the shared builders.
